name: @mole/vscode
description: A map of the file you are looking at, beside the code: what it defines, who calls it, what it calls, who imports it. Local only, TypeScript.

mole.autoOpen.description: Open the map panel beside the editor on startup.

mole.tsconfig.description: tsconfig to take compiler options from (default: none, built-in defaults).

mole.srcDir.description: Folder to index, relative to the workspace (default: src if it exists, otherwise the whole workspace; node_modules, dist and dot-folders are skipped).

mole.stateDir.description: Where the daemon keeps its lock and graph (default: .git/mole).

mole.daemonCli.description: Advanced: path to a Mole daemon cli. Default: the one bundled with this extension.

mole.idleMinutes.description: The background indexer stops after this many minutes without a request and is restarted when needed (0 = never stop).

mole.recordSeen.description: Record which symbols you looked at (visible for 5 s or hovered) in .mole/local/seen.jsonl, so `mole since` can list what changed after your last look. Personal: the folder is gitignored and never leaves this machine.
